comment: What the « LGV France » dataset is made of. bbox: south, west, north, east (degrees), the whole of metropolitan France. Tiles of tileDeg degrees are asked one by one for the high-speed tracks. The approaches are the classic lines that take the trains from the end of a high-speed line into a city-centre terminal: a corridor of waypoints (lat, lon), the rails within radiusM of it, and every rail within stationRadiusM of the terminal. Waypoints are the stations of the SNCF list along the way, plus a few places where the line bends between two stations. lines: names and ids given to the OSM line relations, by their ref (the six-digit RFN line code); a relation without an entry here is named after its OSM name.
